content.name: Kavya Iyer
content.title: Associate Product Manager
content.summary: Associate product manager at a Pune electric two-wheeler company, with a B.Tech in Computer Science and an MBA from a Pune business school. Own the rider app's charging station finder, where a redesign raised weekly active riders by 15%. My summer internship at an edtech start-up taught me to start with user calls, not feature lists.

experience.title: Associate Product Manager
bullets: Own the charging station finder in the rider app used by about 55,000 scooter owners in Maharashtra and Karnataka.
Redesigned station search with live availability and Marathi and Hindi labels, increasing weekly active riders by 15%.
Write PRDs and run sprint reviews with a team of five engineers and one designer.
Track app ratings and support tickets weekly, and fixed the top three crash causes with the Android lead.

experience.title: Product Management Intern
bullets: Conducted 25 calls with parents and Class X students to understand why practice tests went unfinished.
Proposed shorter daily quizzes with streaks; a two-week pilot raised test completion from 31% to 44%.
Presented the final recommendation to the founders, who added it to the next quarter's roadmap.

education.school: Symbiosis Institute of Business Management, Pune
education.details: CGPA 8.2/10. Head of the product club.

achievements.title: Product case competition
achievements.detail: Won a B-school product case competition among 60 teams (2024).

achievements.title: Hackathon
achievements.detail: Built a bus-arrival SMS service at a college hackathon; finished in the top 5 of 40 teams.
